name: botbridge-webcam
description: Give LLM agents webcam access: capture photos and record short videos over MCP.
long_description: Bot Bridge Webcam is an MCP server that gives a locally running LLM agent access to a USB or built-in webcam. It exposes an in-chat control panel plus tools to take a single JPEG photo or record a short video clip, releasing the camera when it is done so other applications can use it. Runs over stdio, so it works in desktop MCP clients without a separate network port.

camera_index.title: Camera index
camera_index.description: Which webcam to open. 0 is usually the built-in camera; try 1 for a second USB camera.
